title: Epstein prison cell video metadata edited

tellings.quote:
Wired magazine, a fairly conventional [music]
tech publication, just revealed that the
metadata from Jeffrey Epstein's prison
cell video [music] that was supposed to
point to a suicide had been edited,
likely using Adobe Premiere.

plain: The video from the jail cell where Jeffrey Epstein died in 2019, footage meant to show a suicide, had its metadata edited, the hidden file data that records how a video was made, probably with the editing program Adobe Premiere. Michels tells this himself, crediting a 2025 report in Wired, which he calls a fairly ordinary tech magazine. He raises it as a sign that the official account of the death may have been tampered with.
